items: Designed the entire B2B procurement platform end to end as the lead and sole product designer, from research and information architecture to final UI.
Work directly with the leadership team to turn business goals into product features and a clear product roadmap.
Designed dashboards for order tracking and procurement management, simplifying high-volume transactions for business buyers.
Designed marketing landing pages that present the platform's value to new business partners.
Built the design system, high-fidelity prototypes and developer-ready specs used by the engineering team.
Core designer for a US design and development company, delivering a large volume of client projects across industries.
Designed DTC brand websites and e-commerce stores, from brand-led visuals to conversion-focused product pages.
Designed AI products, mobile apps, websites and CRM systems for the company's startup and business clients.
Worked with lead designers and engineers from concept to launch, handling multiple projects in parallel on tight deadlines.
Key designer for a student-services platform covering university admissions, scholarships and accommodation; the company raised €10M in funding during this period.
Ran user research, ideation, sketching and prototyping to design features aligned with the CEO's product strategy.
Created and maintained the design system used across all products, keeping the experience consistent.
Delivered production-ready files and supported developers during implementation.
Led the design team for a book-summary app on iOS and Android, owning wireframes, prototypes and final UI.
Researched user needs to guide design decisions and managed design delivery with developers.
Designed wireframes, prototypes and visual designs for a social media platform.
Designed B2B and B2C e-commerce journeys, from wireframes to final UI.
Top Rated on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score; 500+ completed orders and 350+ five-star reviews on Fiverr.
Delivered UI/UX for SaaS, AI products, healthcare, law firms, e-commerce and mobile apps, including motion and micro-interactions.
